     own run in the tool (which is what it's
     for), and gets the tool's own validated
     output. Avoids handing them a hand-built file
     that could differ subtly from what the tool
     produces.
  2. Hand-build it now
     I build the 113-column export by hand from
     the attached files per the request (blank
     the id column, keep the archived rows, pull
     the child records from the audit report),
     validate it, and attach it to the reply.
     Higher effort; I would flag the archived-row
     judgment call for review.
  3. Re-run it in the tool
     With your OK I trigger a fresh managed-agents
     run on the three attached files to produce
     the tool's own output. Note: this costs
     money and appears in the session list.
  4. Type something.
